Remove any wording that says the ledger/offline path uses the owner's account login as the bot identity. Keep it concise.
2. **github-app-api-compat.md milestone status** (~line 456-462, the Implementation Log / milestone status section) — mark the shipped property tests, documentation, and dogfood fixture work complete; the log should list only remaining M5 work as pending. Read the section first; the coordinator already updated the file header (Status) and M1/M2/M3 entries — only adjust the milestone-status/remaining-work lines if they still claim open items that are actually done (e.g. property tests for repository_dispatch payload passthrough, docs, dogfood fixture). Do not rewrite other sections.
3. **github-app-webhook.md env table** (~line 60-66) — add two rows to the environment-variable configuration table (Section 2, next to the PRELOOP_GITHUB_TOKEN row): `PRELOOP_GITHUB_APPS_JSON` (JSON array of additional registered Apps overriding `github.apps`; each entry: `app_id`, `pem`, optional `webhook_secret`/`installation_id`; example `[{"app_id":12345,"pem":"-----BEGIN..."}]`) and `PRELOOP_GITHUB_APP_DEFAULT_EVENTS` (comma-separated creation-time event list for the App-manifest flow; defaults to `push,pull_request`). Match the table's existing formatting (pipe alignment, code backticks).
4. **github_app.rs default_index doc** (~line 519-526 and the `GitHubApps`/`default_app` doc comments) — coderabbit: `load_from` pushes the legacy App first only when both id and key resolve; with registry-only configs `apps[0]` is the first additional App but `default_index` stays hardcoded 0, and the doc comments claim the default index entry is ALWAYS the legacy env-var App. Fix the DOCUMENTATION (do not change behavior): update the doc comments on `GitHubApps`/`default_app`/`load_from` to say the entry at `default_index` is "the first registered App (the legacy App when configured, otherwise the first `github.apps` entry)", and add a brief note in load_from where `default_index` is defined that it is 0 because the legacy App, when present, is pushed first. Keep bootstrap.rs's skip logic consistent (it skips default_index because state.github_app mirrors it — that stays correct).

# Acceptance
- Doc edits minimal and precise; markdown tables keep valid pipes. github_app.rs: comments only, no code behavior change.
- Report per item: exact changes.

 /// Registry of every configured GitHub App.
 ///
-/// The legacy single-App env vars (`PRELOOP_GITHUB_APP_ID` + PEM) are always
-/// the first entry — the default for minting fallback and the App `AppState`
-/// reports as `github_app`. Additional Apps come from `github.apps` in the
-/// config file or the `PRELOOP_GITHUB_APPS_JSON` environment variable.
+/// The entry at [`GitHubApps::default_index`] is the first registered App —
+/// the legacy single-App env vars (`PRELOOP_GITHUB_APP_ID` + PEM) when
+/// configured, otherwise the first `github.apps` entry (config file or
+/// `PRELOOP_GITHUB_APPS_JSON`). It is the default for minting fallback and
+/// the App `AppState` reports as `github_app`. Additional Apps come after it
+/// in registry order.
 #[derive(Clone)]
 pub(crate) struct GitHubApps {
     pub(crate) apps: Vec<GitHubAppCredentials>,
-    /// Index of the legacy env-var App within `apps`.
+    /// Index of the default App within `apps` — the legacy env-var App when
+    /// configured, otherwise the first `github.apps` entry.
     pub(crate) default_index: usize,
 }
 
 impl GitHubApps {
-    /// The default App — the legacy env-var one.
+    /// The default App — the first registered App (the legacy env-var App
+    /// when configured, otherwise the first `github.apps` entry).
     pub(crate) fn default_app(&self) -> &GitHubAppCredentials {
         &self.apps[self.default_index]
     }
